correctness.rationale: Backward generator with the correct outgoing velocity at each absorbing end gives exact marked generating functions. A uniform no-reversal ballistic exit probability gives geometric tails and differentiability. Second-order expansions yield exact rational mean/variance contrasts. Positive rational derivative numerators establish uniqueness, and substitution at the mean root yields strictly negative variance contrast. Symbolic checker and independent matrix evaluations passed; finite diagnostics are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Reversal count conditioned on which absorbing side is reached is a physically motivated activity burden. The theorem gives a natural all-parameter classification, exact onset for mean-order reversal, a variance-order reversal at every rate, a strict region where their rankings disagree, and a quantified cubic boundary-layer width. It is not a routine unmarked splitting probability or a one-parameter numerical case.
